Privacy by design defense in depth · four layers
Insights are aggregated and audited so that no single person or organization can be identified.
No single layer is a perfect guarantee. Together they act as defense in depth, driving the amount of private information in Clio's visible output to undetectable levels.

THE FOUR PRIVACY LAYERS
01
Conversation summary
The model answers the summary question while being instructed to omit any private information.
02
Aggregation thresholds
Clusters are retained only if they exceed minimum unique-account and conversation counts.
03
Cluster summary
When naming clusters, the model is again instructed to exclude any private information.
04
Cluster auditing
An auditor model reads every cluster summary and removes any that still contain private information.
